clean_body: They try to suppress our vote because they know how powerful we are. We still have $2,000 left to raise! = We wanted to make sure you saw Laila’s message from yesterday. We’re in the final sprint to the end of this quarter – and with the primary election almost here, we must hit our voter registration goals. This year is a vital year to register as many voters as possible to expand the electorate. We'll always remind you that the folks we are registering have been disenfranchised due to bad acts. It’s critical that we reach out to these communities and ensure they vote their values twice a year in Pennsyvlania’s elections. = = Power to all the people, Team NPP Voter Registration Fund \----------------------------FWD:---------------------------- | RED ALERT: The quarter is almost over. We’re halfway to our goal, but we still need to raise $2,000! = As the first quarter of 2022 ends in two days, we can’t sugarcoat this. We need your help to get to the finish line. With everything happening in our state, our country, and the world, we understand why it’s hard to give right now. But the only way we are going to solve the problems facing Pennsylvanians and our communities is by making our voices heard at the polls and voting our values. = = Any money we raise will go directly to expanding our field team and empowering Black, brown, and young voters to become voters who show up twice a year to the polls. I have knocked on doors where people had no knowledge that there were elections happening. Others say outright, “I’m not going to register to vote because it doesn’t matter.” We must inspire communities to speak up and vote because it matters. = = In honor of being the change we want to see in the world, Laila Martin Garcia Director of Organizing The New Pennsylvania Project | The New Pennsylvania Project was founded in May 2021 to expand Pennsylvania’s electorate, so it reflects the Commonwealth’s demographically changing population. In the next four years, NPP will engage and empower young residents and those living in underrepresented communities of color and immigrant communities. subject: What Pelosi said last week
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Last week Nancy Pelosi made it clear. No matter the circumstances, she’s
backing all of her House incumbents 100%.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/101083?refcode=em20220330-22634&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=22634%2E1203867%2EzNiddp ]Tweet from Madlin Mekelburg that reads Asked about #TX28 runoff, Seaker
Pelosi says she is continuing to support incumbent Rep. Henry Cuellar.“I
support my incumbents. I support every one of them.”Asked about FBI raid
of his home, she says: “I haven’t seen anything, have you? Do you know
what it’s about?

Jessica Cisneros is challenging Henry Cuellar, who is against abortion
rights, immigrant justice, union organizing, and tanked the President’s
Build Back Better plan. Other Justice Democrats are challenging corporate
incumbents who have prioritized the interests of their corporate donors
over fighting for their constituents. Pelosi has fundraised for at least
one of the other incumbents we’re challenging — Rep. Danny Davis in
Illinois.

We’re behind our slate of JD challengers 100% but they’re facing an uphill
battle against Pelosi and the Democratic establishment. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/101083?refcode=em20220330-22634&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=22634%2E1203867%2EzNiddp ]Can you chip in
$3 to ensure we can secure these critical primary victories
in 2022?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/101083?refcode=em20220330-22634&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=22634%2E1203867%2EzNiddp ]Contribute $3

Justice Democrats like Jessica Cisneros, Kina Collins, and Rana Abdelhamid
are running to be representatives of the people. The incumbents they are
challenging cater to the interests of health insurance companies, the real
estate industry, and big corporations. Jessica, Kina, and Rana will fight
for the people.

Nancy Pelosi made it clear that the Democratic establishment backs
corporate incumbents, and that she will fight to keep them all in
Congress. But in a country plagued by a broken health care system, a
worsening climate crisis, and failing infrastructure, status quo members
of Congress aren’t good enough anymore.

Ayanna Pressley, AOC, Jamaal Bowman, and Cori Bush have all made an
enormous impact in Congress after defeating incumbents. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/101083?refcode=em20220330-22634&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=22634%2E1203867%2EzNiddp ]Please chip in
if you can so we can expand the Squad and elect more members of Congress
like them.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/101083?refcode=em20220330-22634&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1024&akid=22634%2E1203867%2EzNiddp ]Contribute $3

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1025&akid=22634%2E1203867%2EzNiddp ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1026&akid=22634%2E1203867%2EzNiddp ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20220330-22634-footer&t=1027&refcode2=22634_1203867_zNiddp&akid=22634%2E1203867%2EzNiddp

subject: Fighting climate change on Day One
body:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/FAWlogo_Blue%404x.png]
Dear Peter,
I’m just reaching out to make sure you have a chance to learn about my plan to combat climate change by making Maryland the first net zero state in the nation, and to sign on as a Citizen Co-Sponsor to support my efforts. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/av-HXh7bTUqHxGlKrUls9A2]
Climate change is one of the greatest existential threats to our way of life – and Maryland’s communities stand to bear the brunt from its devastating effects due to our miles of shorelines, low-lying areas, and treasured natural resources.
https://secure.ngpvan.com/av-HXh7bTUqHxGlKrUls9A2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/av-HXh7bTUqHxGlKrUls9A2]
Combating climate change must be a top priority for Maryland’s next Governor. That’s why on Day One of my gubernatorial administration, I’ll put Maryland on track to become the first net zero carbon emissions state in the nation by 2030. I’ll take urgent action through two executive orders:
1.
I’ll
sign
an
executive
order
requiring
all
energy
consumed
by
state
government
entities
to
be
created
by
100%
renewable
energy
where
possible,
with
a
mandate
for
full
conversion
by
the
end
of
my
first
term.
2.
I’ll
sign
an
executive
order
requiring
more
renewable
energy
to
be
created
within
Maryland
than
all
energy
consumed
within
the
state.
As a major consumer of power, the state government can lead the private energy sector’s transition to renewables by creating and sustaining demand that further drives investment in renewable infrastructure. A long-term commitment to renewables led by the state will additionally motivate utility partners and private enterprises to invest in renewable infrastructure, and generate more jobs for Marylanders.
We cannot afford to pass the buck on climate change to the next generation. If you agree that we need a Governor who will lead the transition to a new, green economy, will you sign on to my plan to make Maryland the first net zero state in the nation? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/av-HXh7bTUqHxGlKrUls9A2]
Thank you,
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/Franchot%20Signature.png]

name: Morgan Harper Volunteer Alert
subject: We need your help in Cresco
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Morgan Harper for Ohio
body:
[ https://act.morganharper.org/go/1512?refcode=em20220330-871-footer-ak&t=1002&akid=871%2E90090%2EW3TbRg ]Morgan Harper

Hey 👋 —

Welcome to the Morganizing community digest. ✨This is a newsletter where
we’ll share ways that you can get involved in your community.

We hope you’ll enjoy these opportunities to get involved and help build a
strong grassroots movement to send Morgan to the U.S. Senate!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Cresco Community Opportunities:

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

— Canvasses near you 📋 —

We are knocking doors across the state to identify Morgan supporters, and
talk to undecided Democratic voters about the issues that matter most to
them and why Morgan is the best person to represent them in the U.S.
Senate. Closer to the election, we’ll also be reaching back out to
supporters to make sure they have a plan to vote! [ https://act.morganharper.org/go/21440?refcode=em20220330-871&t=1003&akid=871%2E90090%2EW3TbRg ]If you would like to
get involved with this effort or learn more, please click here to find
canvasses happening near you.

[ https://act.morganharper.org/go/21440?refcode=em20220330-871&t=1004&akid=871%2E90090%2EW3TbRg ]Sign up here »

— Other volunteer opportunities 🗂️ —

If there isn’t a canvass happening near you, please consider hosting a
canvass in your community or volunteering in another way! Regardless of
your location or experience level, we have plenty of ways that you can
support the campaign by volunteering – including opportunities to
volunteer remotely. [ https://act.morganharper.org/signup/mh-website-volunteer/?refcode=em20220330-871&t=1005&akid=871%2E90090%2EW3TbRg ]Click here to fill out our volunteer form and we’ll
reach out to you with more information.

[ https://act.morganharper.org/signup/mh-website-volunteer/?refcode=em20220330-871&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1006&akid=871%2E90090%2EW3TbRg ]Sign up here »

— Voter registration 🗳️ —

We
wanted to make sure you’re aware that the last day to register to vote in
the primary election in Ohio is April 4th. [ https://act.morganharper.org/go/29354?t=1007&akid=871%2E90090%2EW3TbRg ]Early voting then starts on
April 5th. Please click here to register to vote.

Register to vote »

Thank you for everything you do,

Team Morganize

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Did you enjoy this newsletter? Please consider forwarding it to a friend
or sharing it on social media. That way even more people can find out
about Morgan’s progressive campaign for U.S. Senate and get involved. We
really appreciate your support! 🥰

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. To remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.morganharper.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=1008&akid=871%2E90090%2EW3TbRg

Paid for by Morgan Harper for Ohio.

name: Max Steiner
subject: Another LaMalfa e-newsletter. Another takedown by yours truly.
body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/43577862/337797174/390307162?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NGIxYmQxNS01OWIwLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0pvMtTTZR-bglwWCAikUscNbbv_HMCVUsdaVLvvopCA=)
Friend,

The latest LaMalfa e-newsletter just hit my inbox. I'll dive right in.

**Doug LaMalfa claims he is “standing up for rural America” -- this is a lie.** Doug LaMalfa stands for no one except big welfare farmers like himself. So, let’s tear apart his latest piece of low-effort campaign material pretending to be a district update.

I want to start with Doug LaMalfa’s section on Ukraine. Like LaMalfa, I too am happy that Ukraine has shown the capability and resolve to force the Russian assault to a standstill. But just because the “line of Russian advance” has stopped moving forward, doesn’t mean that we can pat ourselves on the back. Hundreds of Ukrainian civilians are dying every day to Russian artillery and airstrikes. LaMalfa doesn’t even mention them. LaMalfa also ignores the ongoing praise for Putin coming from his ideological allies like Tucker Carlson, or from the current leader of the Republican Party -- ex-President Donald Trump.

**We must never forget that Trump’s first impeachment was about blackmailing Ukraine into pursuing a bogus investigation of Hunter Biden by withholding anti-tank munitions they desperately needed to defend themselves. LaMalfa voted against impeaching Trump. The blood of Ukraine is on his hands.**

One further difference, unlike LaMalfa, I believe we should implement a No Fly Zone. The only off-ramp we should give Putin is defeat. A No Fly Zone will protect Ukrainian civilians and hasten Russian military collapse. We must not let Putin use the threat of nuclear weapons to blackmail us into letting him claim a victory. If we do, every rival nuclear power will be emboldened to attack our allies: North Korea will demand reunification with South Korea, China will demand Taiwan, and Iran will demand the end of Israel.

I know that I am more hawkish than many of you reading this email. But as a soldier, a diplomat, and a defense researcher, I am alarmed by the resigned pacifism of the Biden Administration and Washington Establishment on this issue. Appeasing megalomaniac dictators does not make us safer. It did not in 1938 Czechoslovakia, and it will not in 2022 Ukraine. We need to stand up for our values, and that means accepting risk. How many more maternity hospitals do we let Putin bomb before we call his bluff?

Anyways, back to LaMalfa’s propaganda. LaMalfa devotes half of his email to complaining about inflation. Yes, gas prices are up. That is because we are selling much of our gas to Europe to replace Russian exports. There’s a war on, prices go up. Apparently LaMalfa would have complained about prices going up during World War Two. He also ignores one of the biggest drivers of price inflation: increased consolidation by industry, which allows them to charge monopoly prices.

Look at PG&E as an example. It is massively increasing rates. They’re doing this because they can, because consumers have no where else to go. LaMalfa doesn’t criticize PG&E in his email though, probably because he’s still accepting campaign contributions from them and they have bought his silence.

LaMalfa ends his email with an ode to American agriculture and criticism of environmental regulations. Doug brags about U.S. agriculture productivity increasing, but then criticizes the regulations that have sparked this growth. He then begs for more cash, claiming that “incentivizing farmers, instead of overburdening them, works best.” I read that as “please throw more money at me and my friends, we don’t want more rules though.” It’s sad, I talk to a lot of farmers and ranchers throughout the district who DON’T get a million-dollar farm check every year. LaMalfa can’t talk about agriculture without asking for a handout.**He’s not a real farmer, he’s not “one of us,” he’s a welfare farmer... who votes against welfare for those that actually need it.**

clean_body: | = Friend, The latest LaMalfa e-newsletter just hit my inbox. I'll dive right in. Doug LaMalfa claims he is “standing up for rural America” -- this is a lie. Doug LaMalfa stands for no one except big welfare farmers like himself. So, let’s tear apart his latest piece of low-effort campaign material pretending to be a district update. I want to start with Doug LaMalfa’s section on Ukraine. Like LaMalfa, I too am happy that Ukraine has shown the capability and resolve to force the Russian assault to a standstill. But just because the “line of Russian advance” has stopped moving forward, doesn’t mean that we can pat ourselves on the back. Hundreds of Ukrainian civilians are dying every day to Russian artillery and airstrikes. LaMalfa doesn’t even mention them. LaMalfa also ignores the ongoing praise for Putin coming from his ideological allies like Tucker Carlson, or from the current leader of the Republican Party -- ex-President Donald Trump. We must never forget that Trump’s first impeachment was about blackmailing Ukraine into pursuing a bogus investigation of Hunter Biden by withholding anti-tank munitions they desperately needed to defend themselves. LaMalfa voted against impeaching Trump. The blood of Ukraine is on his hands. One further difference, unlike LaMalfa, I believe we should implement a No Fly Zone. The only off-ramp we should give Putin is defeat. A No Fly Zone will protect Ukrainian civilians and hasten Russian military collapse. We must not let Putin use the threat of nuclear weapons to blackmail us into letting him claim a victory. If we do, every rival nuclear power will be emboldened to attack our allies: North Korea will demand reunification with South Korea, China will demand Taiwan, and Iran will demand the end of Israel. I know that I am more hawkish than many of you reading this email. But as a soldier, a diplomat, and a defense researcher, I am alarmed by the resigned pacifism of the Biden Administration and Washington Establishment on this issue. Appeasing megalomaniac dictators does not make us safer. It did not in 1938 Czechoslovakia, and it will not in 2022 Ukraine. We need to stand up for our values, and that means accepting risk. How many more maternity hospitals do we let Putin bomb before we call his bluff? Anyways, back to LaMalfa’s propaganda. LaMalfa devotes half of his email to complaining about inflation. Yes, gas prices are up. That is because we are selling much of our gas to Europe to replace Russian exports. There’s a war on, prices go up. Apparently LaMalfa would have complained about prices going up during World War Two. He also ignores one of the biggest drivers of price inflation: increased consolidation by industry, which allows them to charge monopoly prices. Look at PG&E as an example. It is massively increasing rates. They’re doing this because they can, because consumers have no where else to go. LaMalfa doesn’t criticize PG&E in his email though, probably because he’s still accepting campaign contributions from them and they have bought his silence. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez as Justice Democrats because we believe that healthcare is a human right, that education should be equitable and create opportunities for all, and because we believe that we need to take action against today's climate crisis now. * Our Proficiency rates across Wisconsin, indeed the country are down and our leaders have deemed parents as "domestic terrorists."
* Divisive racial theories and Sex Ed. are being pushed down to Pre-K.
* All School Board Candidates are invited free of charge. We want to know who you are and why you are running.

Dr. Duke Pesta is Director of Freedom Project Academy, host of the Dr. Duke Show podcast, and a tenured professor of English at the University of Wisconsin Oshkosh. He is one of America's foremost authorities on the dangers of Critical Race Theory, Common Core, and the federal takeover of education, having delivered over 1000 talks in 48 states. body:
This is the most important deadline of our campaign so far
#

Hi there,
With our FEC deadline coming up at midnight tomorrow, we wanted to take a second to step back and explain a little bit about why exactly this deadline is so important.
After every quarter, the Federal Election Commission requires candidates for federal office — like U.S. Senator for California — to publicly report how much money they’ve raised.
The Q1 deadline is tomorrow at midnight, and it’s extra important because it’s the very first deadline of an election year.
So after this deadline passes and we file our report with the FEC, we need to make sure it sends the right message. If our donation numbers look low, our opponents will see that as a lack of enthusiasm for our campaign and an invitation to ramp up their attacks.
**So we need to put up a massive number of donations to send a message that our campaign is fired up and ready to take on whatever comes our way.**
[**What do you say? Can you add your first contribution to Alex’s campaign for U.S. Senate? Please, do it before our FEC deadline tomorrow at midnight. We’re counting on lots and lots of supporters like you to help demonstrate that our campaign is ready to WIN!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-mar22?refcode=em220330-1-30&t=1&refcode2=708_159979_UcPMPH&akid=708%2E159979%2EUcPMPH)
The truth is, it’s going to take a massive organizing effort in every corner of the state to hold this seat and keep California blue, and the only way we’re going to be able to pull it off is with your support.
Your contribution today, before our deadline tomorrow at midnight, will ensure we have the resources to do just that.
Thank you.
\- Team Alex Padilla

body:
How *exactly* will your campaign donation be spent? You decide.
#
Derek,
Have you ever wondered how online donations to Democratic campaigns are *actually* spent?
Well, I’ve decided I’m not just going to answer that question. I’ll do you one better.
**Today, when you chip in to support our campaign to flip Pennsylvania’s Senate seat blue, you can choose *exactly* which part of our campaign you want to support.👇**
We specifically need help funding the following areas of our campaign before our EOQ deadline tomorrow at midnight: **Volunteer-led organizing, in-person events, advertising, and yard signage.**
**[Can we count on you to support one of these four critical programs today? Choose where to send your donation on our donation page! By donating to a specific campaign program, you’ll have a direct and immediate impact on the success of our campaign.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/46062?refcode=em20220330-5189&t=1&akid=5189%2E434096%2ESNbXBJ)**
**[Donate»](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/46062?refcode=em20220330-5189&t=20&akid=5189%2E434096%2ESNbXBJ)**
**1\. Organizing**
Team Fetterman organizers and volunteers are working around the clock to reach voters in all 67 counties. Just last week, we hosted our first-ever Volunteer Kickoff Phone Bank and made over 16,800 calls to Pennsylvania voters! 🤩
But we’re still ramping up. Soon we’ll be hosting a lot more canvasses + phone banks. And the tools, staff, and training will require more serious funding.
**[Donate now to support our growing organizing program »](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/46091?refcode=em20220330-5189&t=21&akid=5189%2E434096%2ESNbXBJ)**
**2\. In-Person Events**
One of the best ways to build enthusiasm for our campaign is connecting with folks where they live. I visited dozens of communities across PA in March, including places Trump won in a landslide in 2016. Why? Because I refuse to write off anyone in this state, no matter where they live or who they’ve voted for.
My goal is to hit the road as often as I can leading up to our May primary. I’ll need help putting gas in the tank, staffing up events, and getting the word out. 💯
**[Donate now to help launch more in-person events »](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/46092?refcode=em20220330-5189&t=22&akid=5189%2E434096%2ESNbXBJ)**
**3\. Advertising**
This is a big one. Our GOP opponents have collectively spent over $40 million on TV ads, because they want to drown us out. But through grassroots support, we’ve been able to compete and get our first TV ads on the air. Now, we just need your help keeping them up so we can reach Pennsylvanians everywhere. 🙏
**[Donate now to keep our TV ads on the air + in front of voters »](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/46093?refcode=em20220330-5189&t=23&akid=5189%2E434096%2ESNbXBJ)**
**4\. Yard Signs**
No joke, yard signs are a HUGE way for our campaign to get in front of new eyes and demonstrate our widespread support. We’d love to get thousands more in yards and windows across the state. 🇺🇸
**[Donate now to help us put up thousands of Team Fetterman yard signs in PA »](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/46094?refcode=em20220330-5189&t=24&akid=5189%2E434096%2ESNbXBJ)**
TBH, no matter which program you choose to send your donation to -- organizing, events, ads, or signs -- I couldn’t be more grateful for your support, Derek. Each one of these areas of our campaign is part of our path to victory, and they all need more grassroots resources to be successful!
I’ve said it before and I’ll say it again: Thank you, THANK YOU, thank you. ❤️
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
**[Donate»](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/46062?refcode=em20220330-5189&t=25&akid=5189%2E434096%2ESNbXBJ)**

clean_body: What we have seen unfold during this election makes one thing clear. | | | Peter, in a moment, I’m going to ask you to But first, I’d like to explain why we must fight harder than ever to unseat Henry Cuellar on May 24. What we have seen unfold during this election makes one thing clear: South Texans deserve far better than what Henry Cuellar is giving. There is no way around it and there is nothing Cuellar can do to hide his record of failing to deliver for our community. That’s why he did not receive half of the vote during the primary. Despite his home and campaign office being raided by the FBI, Cuellar has gone back to business — hosting thousand-dollar plate fundraisers and receiving thousands from corporations. We deserve a transparent Congressperson who is focused on serving the District,not someone who makes us question their true intentions and serves only their corporate donors. With eight weeks until the runoff, we must do all we can to send Jessica Cisneros, a true progressive champion, to Congress. But we know the fight to defeat Henry Cuellar won’t be easy. Despite the FBI probe, he’s determined to get re-elected. He currently has $2.3 million in campaign cash and is backed by the NRA, Big Oil, the Koch network, the private prison industry, and corporate PACs. He frequently has voted with conservatives in Congress to halt progress on reproductive rights or pro-labor legislation. That’s why we need your help. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: We’re building our power directly from the people — because once elected to Congress, Jessica will work for the people. Not big corporations or PACs. Thank you for supporting our movement, Regina M. Campaign Manager, Team Cisneros | To give by check: PO Box 660 Laredo, TX 78042

If you would like to unsubscribe visit this Peter, Over the weekend, I received Sen. Joni Ernst’s endorsement – and I couldn’t be more honored! Joni’s a fellow combat veteran and mom – and she knows exactly what it takes to lead in the United States Senate. Washington needs battle-tested leaders that are unafraid of ruffling feathers and challenging the status quo. We need leaders that are focused on solving problems for the American people, not becoming career politicians. That’s what Joni’s done and it’s what I plan to do . My name is Marjorie K. Eastman. I’m a veteran, military wife, mother, and businesswoman – and I’m running to represent North Carolina in the U.S. Senate. When I look at the direction our country is heading in, I’m worried. I’m concerned about career politicians’ inability to govern and protect our freedoms. When I joined the Army, I took an oath to protect and defend those freedoms. That’s what I’ve always done – and will continue to do in the U.S. Senate. I bring something unique to this race, Peter. I’m the only combat veteran and conservative outsider. I know what it means to go to war, to put your life on the line for your country. I’ve seen first-hand what freedom trulycosts – and that’s something that can’t be bought. In the days and weeks after 9/11, I was like so many other Americans. I felt compelled to serve my country, and I have – through 10 years of intelligence service and two deployments. When I returned home, I faced a personal battle: my son was diagnosed with cancer. I quickly transitioned back into mom mode. My husband and I prayed every day, and eventually, my son beat his diagnosis. I’ve stood by my husband and supported his military career while also working in the private and non-profit sector, all with their own unique challenges. All of these battles led me to this mission today. Our nation’s best days are ahead of us as long as our leaders are battle-tested and answer to the American people. Thank you, Marjorie K. Peter,

I had just finished serving our great nation in Afghanistan when I decided to take a vacation with my two childhood friends in Europe during 2015. **We were traveling on a Paris-bound train when a terrorist armed with a gun, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over our train.**

As a soldier, I was trained to take out a terrorist threat - As an American, I was taught to stand up for freedom no matter where I was in the world. Which is why I, my friends and other brave travelers took the action needed to stop this terrorist.

For this, the President awarded me the United States Army's Soldier's Medal, and the events of that fateful day were later retold in the film _The 15:17 to Paris,_ directed by Clint Eastwood.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=73841b1d900746a89ecbde8fb4a31833&_e=9JwyKcRY00CsVx5Izid2x_TwzKMsNvp0pRk_e970-aqidslz3s9jyCMo8is56LshyLx-TpFaUqcH7s_1H2D_UamzQ4XfxD9tRXwgn2q0s7YEEUy4VceEwDlzaR7NkjJZGsq5tRzuWGzAFzSA5nRwmlVGVfFky1Mj04Re0C9M-QkNAXyv1IjvcoCBCn5kC_1gJoGSLe5tg5_5naLtp2BYpR5fdojVYktad6tEx4qo2SM41aUO5jJn2xASe6lrgerLXiUPHJGYehI-QqT9a65itUCgTV9QZD2bZlUw0DCM3E1YTvE63_KmAO2tTydb_JLGGMIzAJj_F2fv9-FLMIE7a-pmkLtgX8rEUweVecGXjZ5OU-wYTrrg1_Zbr8tW0I_yLNT7Sg2UQsHmbmO4s-9FJIvTfgLr7ECT0tsg2n1sFq0%3D)Anthony Sadler, Spencer Stone, and I accepting the Hero Award from Clint Eastwood on June 4, 2016, in California.
But I didn’t do what I did to receive recognition – **I did it out of duty.** And now, duty is calling me again.

[**My name is Alek Skarlatos, I am a former National Guardsman, an American Patriot, a proud Republican and I am running for Congress in Oregon’s 4th District.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=73841b1d900746a89ecbde8fb4a31833&_e=9JwyKcRY00CsVx5Izid2x_TwzKMsNvp0pRk_e970-aqidslz3s9jyCMo8is56LshyLx-TpFaUqcH7s_1H2D_UamzQ4XfxD9tRXwgn2q0s7YEEUy4VceEwDlzaR7NkjJZGsq5tRzuWGzAFzSA5nRwmlVGVfFky1Mj04Re0C9M-QkNAXyv1IjvcoCBCn5kC_1goCEnxAv5xy9JluT7zsMGTZXDu5J9b4Zw58w48VrnAdsS9mh-sm4-VqqKEoFJOYpzv5uD-WyKeFXRaCwbI0S2-x6NeES16aKxe28y8sT85qOIRlUydDSmXms0ebWh0lgatzif2ryS4JqEnA_uT4p3iYGGSt_DVdzSFA-r0Ei4kEZEu7NC4KXmqG2PIcD0tGXTbpv1XENv7-d0Jhwr6UIAMsrWms0-QZo7Kmuq3EPkSZo%3D)

body:
I really need us to redouble our commitment to meeting the very ambitious fundraising goals we’ve set if we’re going to have the resources to win.
I feel really good about where we are in this campaign.
At 56,000 people and growing, we’ve got the biggest volunteer organizing team in the country right now. And these volunteers are already at the doors of Texas voters, building relationships and connecting with those who will decide the outcome of this election.
Our digital team is leveraging our social media presence to reach voters — especially young voters — with the messages that give them a reason to care about and vote in this election. It’s also been a powerful recruitment tool to bring in new volunteers.
And Abbott continues to make the case for why he can’t be trusted with another term in office. Whether it’s the grid, the attacks on teachers, the failure to fix Child Protective Services, or the outright banning of reproductive healthcare freedom in Texas, he’s given Texas voters — Republicans as well as Democrats — plenty of reasons to vote for change.
**The only place where I know we could be doing better is fundraising.**
While we’ve kept pace with Abbott on a day to day basis, matching his corporate donors with grassroots support, we started this race more than $50 million behind. I really need us to redouble our commitment to meeting the very ambitious fundraising goals we’ve set if we’re going to have the resources to win.

body:
Generations of Americans have struggled and sacrificed their lives to defend our democracy.
And none of it would be possible without you.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/43582854/337821362/-532505380?refcode=EM_FR_220330Heinrich_EN_MH_90DO_4_NG_N_LOGO&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcyMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyY2Q0NTZjMi02OWIwLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TngOO_pGa6N6braL4wjJ5g8IgL6mUnTMerqWcMMnMuA=)
Team,

I have been thinking a lot about what our country stands for. I’m the son of an immigrant whose family came to the United States from Germany in the 1930s. To me, America is a beacon of liberty, equal justice, and democracy. But all of that has been under threat, as I experienced firsthand on January 6th, 2021.

That makes it so important, now more than ever, that we elect people who are truly committed to liberty, equal justice, and democracy -- **_and that's why I'm endorsing Secretary of State Maggie Toulouse Oliver._**

Maggie is one of the most experienced election administrators in the country. She has a record of defending and expanding voting rights. And she has made sure that voting rights and democracy in our state are protected, even while those same values are under threat elsewhere across the country. It is critical we support Maggie in her run for another four years.

[**I wouldn’t ask unless it was important: will you defend New Mexico’s democracy and help reelect a leader who will uphold our constitutional right to vote? It's critical Maggie wins this November.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/43582855/337821363/-532505380?refcode=EM_FR_220330Heinrich_EN_MH_90DO_4_NG_N_LOGO&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcyMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyY2Q0NTZjMi02OWIwLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TngOO_pGa6N6braL4wjJ5g8IgL6mUnTMerqWcMMnMuA=)

body:
We’ve watched wealth and income disparities in the United States grow worse with every passing year, and absurdly accelerate since the pandemic. We’d like—with your support—to reverse that trend. | | |
---
[](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953yRkW_Sw2xr1MvIXEt6jooTbMnsVYqhUO8Xwt4ORz78ORT8Pt3SALA3pMGVDypeKbyy2kgsjsCmnmy8k7FgsqB6wuCJ9K2SYervuUQSBWz0O6-eElc5v5iLtRM3tW5Yplyv9Ad3GEz2ZVjgzIZS4d36ApBuwSuNM3ncufr4fQL8wNcIxo19yXrLRyAoMpXC2Vtt_1Asp0v9BtOK-fSGSlp3t3AXeZww7STQu9smqp5hcHYTSEt7lmRSH1isX8KeWASctDMSPLrsp3IoX0ysn9egb0jGbSqn7AxLeHTTvcysBB4rMX5JX_cHfBhzdVoQMrPRIGSoV8vhJ-gMJp7Slqa4RvuYqPm4i568h6BP4pZJuocAFXC-CWxD4bHuvfQemdM/3ks/p_DBl94QRLuuAOm_mjrPvw/h0/Vvu0vkmuyfKmkd1R8XXpQYSlkWIRP-6KZ3J_aaV7C1g)
| | Dear Peter, **** Are you tired of watching oligarchs in Congress fill the pockets of billionaires and robber barons? [**Join us today to send a class warrior for the 99% to Congress!**](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTCxhAMhTRXK4t_BbI_sQ5MKiTMG7gvqoJJY24g2sVW2yuXgFrhlb2s5er6HTIDJTacLaNQ6fzjxIX_D7ZkIFr83mZkpLIfDrySOP4N1onow8T9IFPlzuPORCYvigaFUafaTavH5jtw9HULXINs2dxtnXAoZdfcbJqvSff0e_80Cs_8heaEL2UpbyBydLaCX4F003WzHwj972tdOdcFv6Z5fNHVaRSUMOSzBrkT09yL5j0bcuTHiWyQBJPLT1dnIiFey_Bm3b7-Qen5uqUaTe_blvSoR4UQ10csk57p6otA_51uD_nOgSn88bw9Ie1_9IptAiuP2WKgSQyLMuGvccEG0/3ks/p_DBl94QRLuuAOm_mjrPvw/h1/u81krJ-P1ijHNSNlyXnYcHFDEgTBsEKzeaIxNFMmwN4) In Washington, a Congress of millionaires has repeatedly prioritized targeted tax breaks for the wealthy, while freezing the federal minimum wage for over a decade. Meanwhile, working families are struggling with a mounting economic crisis that has stretched beyond supply chain issues and now reached the stage of predicted food shortages. Having lost my childhood home to foreclosure as a teenager, and then struggled to fund my education (for which I'm still indebted to this day), I'm no stranger to struggle. Are you tired of Washington ignoring predictions and running straight into brick walls over and over again? From climate chaos to public health, corporate Democrats continue to join their Republican allies in choosing to ignore science, disregard long overdue reforms—and force working Americans to pay the price. [**Are you ready to remove the gatekeeper guarding for-profit healthcare and replace her with a new voice favoring human rights to basic human needs including housing, healthcare, and food?**](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTCxhAMhTRXK4t_BbI_sQ5MKiTMG7gvqoJJY24g2sVW2yuXgFrhlb2s5er6HTIDJTafVVkGyRTq5XkTvl8uP855fNxLXzuWqE-wlxvoCEWlKQyApef5rtmKUbvAIgBRep6dN-b5Y1k0KFHKijPpNvsgdWmzU91fRHa1q3RLf5GyqiTW7rHOk3gtCWcj2_i5hkMDGyXKLSM9YJZ9pw9NL54a-meK3vFmU4-j5RjeEUPqgM3E8pnBEhmpWDt7kVSXb30OJiDR3mzMyVviMaCyVCrQ_MqPWZCcHKkZwfMaorHkyOhQaC5Mr5lGkzW3g44AwVUmK11baZaEFK5HB5yEwNpXo/3ks/p_DBl94QRLuuAOm_mjrPvw/h2/huSwdT5-xkuNdTvbwNYDo2UXbDUlmnweFuKKn6YobRA) Today, Americans are reeling from levels of medical debt never before seen in human history. It is the overlooked rot at the core of an already collapsing economy, and an empire all-too-willing to force its costs onto the most vulnerable. In every industrialized country in the world—except the U.S.—people enjoy healthcare as a matter of right. Their systems differ, but the one thing none of them do is force patients and their families to endure lifetimes of medical debt. When you’re sick, you should be able to focus on your health, and getting better. But for too many Americans, falling ill forces worry—or worse—over making ends meet. It shouldn’t be a struggle to keep mouths fed, or a roof over your head, when you’re sick. In fact, it isn’t a struggle elsewhere. Only here, in the richest country in the history of humanity, is medical debt the leading cause of homelessness. It’s a shame, a vicious cycle, and a clear reflection of bipartisan policy failure. [**Ready for change? Join us today to force change on a system that concedes nothing without a demand!**](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTCxhAMhTRXK4t_BbI_sQ5MKiTMG7gvqoJJY24g2sVW2yuXgFrhlb2s5er6HTIDJTaeVIeMPXeGqKtqCtaf-IYHCVKz8vqMctrT6UxeqaQOWNaYMWkiw45waEirLqdU_v0DtW-hfK0mT80LLu8bvJ-rHEE5r4vd7zWLJWLeVKpX7xhuQmQckw-HbyxGthSvqPY9O7FFs2LHMcBcFeOD_HYtMnvEnHR12A6dNAzDWV4HWQ3jDKhdwDg_a6JEWi2C4rlWELFKK_k5JlZskSItPhMgw04FR_yT34q7DVrHLM6lf_B5pFzevAKyTZ15Bn3hGlY1XGTYeg9rRShmlfq3T1DZI/3ks/p_DBl94QRLuuAOm_mjrPvw/h3/AwalCMc6h0FW3g87LpGWmKP289X8GwMRPCSqyItQDFg) In addition to fighting for universal healthcare free at the point of service, I’d also like to establish a human right to housing, and a new era of social housing to shift resources from the military-industrial complex to the most pressing needs confronting our communities. As an immigrant challenging an oligarch to defend the future from the failures of the past, I’m painfully aware of how outgunned I am. That’s why I’m grateful for your support, and why we’re making every dollar stretch. As we close in on the critical FEC disclosure deadline at midnight EST on Thursday, your help has never been more crucial to our campaign! Your voice,
Shahid PS — Want to do more to support our campaign, end the Pelosi dynasty, and liberate Democrats from co-optation by Wall Street? **[Sign up to volunteer](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTNyy0c_kMvO1sM-_6WbdMUELUaWj_7LwLaWbfvP7JKlLP6_xQCIhbEtnJtOFmKq5nNTG6snRTX1y1KRXns8swjUjdF3QNKkGRo-ZJzBdVxGe8zs8zewVh5ZUPpZJSDdKIyvt87rigTjis9bEJPDO_fTzRPZnDAwymwS2ajig7uNYF02lF4ifQuquBZcYQjveKAHDcoNF7O6K2IDbzw-s57sxx9VctdZv-KwJPwc23sG9471Z6oS8jrrLovrgfzPlj4Ra32zgzzCv0jAAbI-XIny0Jqpxv4sznKUUJF_L8AYm/3ks/p_DBl94QRLuuAOm_mjrPvw/h4/LHYAQd5OW-pdDDdZeYaNJnWfp4v3UAu7lncFpuVL6eo) from wherever ****you liv****e**!**** If you’d like to host a videoconference to introduce our work to others in your community who share our concerns, reply to this email and let us know when you have in mind. I’m looking forward to meeting you, as well as your friends, family, neighbors, colleagues, and classmates! |

name: Lena Moffitt, Evergreen Action
subject: Tell the EPA: Clean air is "appropriate and necessary"
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY EVERGREEN ACTION
body:
Sign an official public comment to influence EPA decision-makers!
| [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/tell-EPA-clean-air-pollution/?utm_source=ema_2022-03-30_EPA_MATS_comment_&source=ema_2022-03-30_EPA_MATS_comment_&t=2&akid=12959%2E53494%2E1S3hni) | _This email marks the start of Evergreen's newest policy push: our**100% Clean Power Campaign.** Together, we'll mobilize support for EPA rules & reforms and win critical victories for our clean energy future.
Interested? [**_Act today to stay in the loop!_**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/tell-EPA-clean-air-pollution/?utm_source=ema_2022-03-30_EPA_MATS_comment_&source=ema_2022-03-30_EPA_MATS_comment_&t=3&akid=12959%2E53494%2E1S3hni)_
---
Friend,
Let's state the obvious: Clean air is **necessary.**
That's why the Environmental Protection Agency was created—to enforce the _Clean Air Act_ and stop polluters. It's the definition of **appropriate** work for the agency.
But in 2020, the Trump administration gutted a key public health standard from the EPA, claiming that it was **not "appropriate or necessary" for the agency to limit toxic air pollution from power plants.**
To put it mildly, we disagree. That's why we're thrilled that the EPA is reconsidering this Trump-era change—and right now, we have a chance to not only bring the rule back, but strengthen it. [**_Will you sign an official public comment today to tell the EPA that clean air is "appropriate and necessary"? (We'll submit it on your behalf directly to EPA decision-makers!)_**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/tell-EPA-clean-air-pollution/?utm_source=ema_2022-03-30_EPA_MATS_comment_&source=ema_2022-03-30_EPA_MATS_comment_&t=4&akid=12959%2E53494%2E1S3hni)
[SIGN A PUBLIC COMMENT](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/tell-EPA-clean-air-pollution/?utm_source=ema_2022-03-30_EPA_MATS_comment_&source=ema_2022-03-30_EPA_MATS_comment_&t=5&akid=12959%2E53494%2E1S3hni)
---
Coal- and oil-fired power plants are directly harming families across the U.S. by contributing to high rates of asthma, cancer, heart disease, and other health threats—and those hardest hit are children, Indigenous communities, people of color, and low-income communities.
Since 2012, the EPA's Mercury and Air Toxics Standards (MATS) have dramatically reduced the toxic air pollutants linked to these diseases and improved air quality for all Americans, especially these at-risk communities—until the Trump Administration gutted the rule.
[**_Every single one of us deserves clean air. Will you sign an official public comment right now demanding the EPA restore MATS and set even stronger standards to reduce toxic air pollution?_**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/tell-EPA-clean-air-pollution/?utm_source=ema_2022-03-30_EPA_MATS_comment_&source=ema_2022-03-30_EPA_MATS_comment_&t=6&akid=12959%2E53494%2E1S3hni)
[SIGN A PUBLIC COMMENT](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/tell-EPA-clean-air-pollution/?utm_source=ema_2022-03-30_EPA_MATS_comment_&source=ema_2022-03-30_EPA_MATS_comment_&t=7&akid=12959%2E53494%2E1S3hni)
---
This is an opportunity to directly influence policy and push the EPA to do more to protect our families and communities. We'll submit these public comments straight to EPA decision-makers, so sign yours today and help win clean air for all!
Together,
Lena Moffitt
Chief of Staff, Evergreen Action

York County GOP Chair Jeff Piccola announced his endorsement at a press conference Wednesday. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/billmcswain/york-county-gop-and-chairman-jeff-piccola-announce-support-for-bill-mcswain-for-governor?e=b1ec95759b)

| **PRESS RELEASE
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
---
**March 30, 2022
CONTACT: Rachel Tripp
202.738.9089**
---
| |
# York County GOP and Chairman Jeff Piccola announce support for Bill McSwain for Governor
**West Chester, Pa.** **\-- **Bill McSwain, Republican candidate for Governor, today announced that he has received the support, approval, and recommendation of the York County Republican Committee, as well as the endorsement of Chairman Jeff Piccola. With over 150,000 registered Republicans, York County has the fifth highest number of registered Republicans among Pennsylvania's 67 counties.

Piccola announced his endorsement at a press conference on Wednesday. He was joined by members of the York GOP as well as local community leaders and activists.

McSwain had this to say about the endorsement:
---
|
> **_"I am proud to receive the endorsement of my friend, Jeff Piccola, Chairman of the York GOP, as well as the support of the entire York County Republican Party. Like many of us, Jeff understands the importance of electing a strong conservative outsider as Governor who will never back down in defense of law-abiding citizens and hard-working Pennsylvanians. I look forward to working with Jeff and the York GOP to create a better future for York and for all 67 counties." _**
---
| Piccola praised McSwain for his history of public service and confirmed his belief that McSwain is the best candidate to lead Pennsylvania:
---
|
> _**"For Governor, we need a principled, conservative leader, someone who can undo the damaging policies of the Wolf administration. Bill McSwain is that leader. **
>
> **Bill McSwain is a conservative, principled man who has dedicated his life to public service, first as a U.S. Marine and then as U.S. Attorney appointed by President Trump. But Bill is more than just a tough-on-crime prosecutor - he also understands the importance of school choice and will put parents, not teachers unions, in charge of our kids' education. He is also the only candidate who can beat Josh Shapiro, and the only candidate who can lead us to a new era of prosperity. I am proud to extend my full endorsement to Bill McSwain for Governor." **_
---
|
---
| **BACKGROUND: **
Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as U.S. Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming an attorney, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. More information on McSwain's background and platform is available [here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=380a58727c&e=b1ec95759b)

Let me get this straight, friend:

**This week, we found out that:**
\- A sitting Supreme Court Justice's wife "repeatedly" texted Trump's Chief of Staff to overturn the 2020 presidential election.

\- The House Committee investigating Jan. 6th is now looking into another Trump "cover-up” after allegations emerged that he used a burner phone on Jan 6th.

\- Kevin McCarthy is still planning to restore Marjorie Taylor Greene's committee assignments after she spoke at a white supremacists rally.

subject: Should I be elected in November
body:
Committee assignments I will seek
---
| | | | | | Volume 34 | March 16, 2022
---
|
---
| A Word From Erik
---
| | |
---|---
|
I seek to represent this district and Colorado in the U.S. Congress because I know that together we can achieve great things for the district, state and the country.
Many have asked me what committees I would ask to serve on if elected. While House leadership makes decisions on committee assignments, I will seek to serve on committees which draw on my experience and put me in the best position to serve my district, the state, and of course this great country.
I can assure you that no matter the committee assignments I receive, I will dive into the job at hand and work tirelessly in service to Colorado.
Here are the committees I will ask the House leadership to consider.
Committee on Armed Services: Service on the Armed Services committee makes great sense for a number of reasons. Colorado has a number of military organizations across a variety of key contributors to national defense. From the U.S. Air Force Academy, molding future Air Force officers, to Ft. Carson that has provided fighting ground forces to all recent conflicts and support operations worldwide, we know that no Coloradoan has to have the meaning of service explained to them.
Other Air Force installations including Cheyenne Mountain AFB, Buckley AFB, Peterson AFB, and Schriever AFB, provide vital support to a vast array of air and space operations. Pueblo Chemical Depot will oversee the full eradication of the remaining U.S. chemical weapons remaining in existence in the country and will do so in a safe manner.
It takes an understanding of how the military works that I gained both as a cadet at West Point and through years of Army service both at home and abroad in combat, such as how to focus our forces on the best defense for our nation, and how to spend the enormous amount of money that is required to support our troops while ensuring continuous modernization.
I can help not only Colorado but also committee members gain and expand their understanding of difficult national defense issues to aid our national leaders to make the right decisions for our forces now and well into the future.
Ultimately, I am committed to ensuring that our military is prepared to fight and win our nations wars. I will stand against the Marxist indoctrination of our service members and hold accountable any flag officer who is not honoring their oath to support and defend the U.S. Constitution against all enemies, foreign and domestic.

Committee on Natural Resources: We've seen in recent months the devastating effects of a Democrat plan to end U.S. energy independence by crushing hydrocarbon industries, especially in light of the obvious fact that no viable alternatives yet exist in a reliable, plentiful, and feasible way. It's not even clear that such an attack on hydrocarbon industries will have discernible effect on climate, while it is clear that the economic consequences are already hurting American families --- just a trip to the local gas station today tells the story for all of us.

When I left the Army, I worked for nine years in the oil and natural gas industry at home and internationally in Israel. I learned there that simplistic thinking isn't enough to consider the way forward. It's also not enough to suggest that we can use an "all-of-the-above" strategy in deciding how best to use a finite amount of money and brainpower in developing new technologies. Whether it's looking at solar, hydropower, nuclear or other technologies to replace oil, natural gas, and coal we have to honestly determine if those other sources really are feasible and economically viable on a large scale. Oil, gas and coal remain vital --- and plentiful --- to the American economy; not only are they viable, but, as we're seeing in the Ukraine situation, they are crucial to a strong national defense.

Committee on Intelligence: As an Army officer, I held a Top Secret clearance. Through my Army experience and my international experience in the oil and gas industry, it is clear to me that national-level intelligence is a critical factor in determining success and failure in the most important decisions in our country. We cannot allow that highly important function to be corrupted by politicians who use it to settle personal or party differences. We must also hold both our political appointees and career intelligence officials to a high standard of person conduct. My experience with intelligence officials tells me that the vast majority of them are patriotic, dedicated Americans who put the security of the nation above their own gain. We must also protect them from those who would use their power for anything less that the best interest of the nation.

Again, I will go head-long into any assignment given, but now it's clear to you the committees I will seek. Our people, in this district, the state of Colorado, and the country as a whole, are profoundly affected by our congressional oversight. Serving our fellow citizens is a noble calling, and I will always adhere to that ethos.

clean_body: Committee assignments I will seek | | | | | | Volume 34 | March 16, 2022 | | A Word From Erik | | | ---|--- | I seek to represent this district and Colorado in the U.S. Congress because I know that together we can achieve great things for the district, state and the country. Many have asked me what committees I would ask to serve on if elected. While House leadership makes decisions on committee assignments, I will seek to serve on committees which draw on my experience and put me in the best position to serve my district, the state, and of course this great country. I can assure you that no matter the committee assignments I receive, I will dive into the job at hand and work tirelessly in service to Colorado. Here are the committees I will ask the House leadership to consider. Committee on Armed Services: Service on the Armed Services committee makes great sense for a number of reasons. Colorado has a number of military organizations across a variety of key contributors to national defense. From the U.S. Air Force Academy, molding future Air Force officers, to Ft. Carson that has provided fighting ground forces to all recent conflicts and support operations worldwide, we know that no Coloradoan has to have the meaning of service explained to them. Other Air Force installations including Cheyenne Mountain AFB, Buckley AFB, Peterson AFB, and Schriever AFB, provide vital support to a vast array of air and space operations. Pueblo Chemical Depot will oversee the full eradication of the remaining U.S. chemical weapons remaining in existence in the country and will do so in a safe manner. It takes an understanding of how the military works that I gained both as a cadet at West Point and through years of Army service both at home and abroad in combat, such as how to focus our forces on the best defense for our nation, and how to spend the enormous amount of money that is required to support our troops while ensuring continuous modernization. I can help not only Colorado but also committee members gain and expand their understanding of difficult national defense issues to aid our national leaders to make the right decisions for our forces now and well into the future. Ultimately, I am committed to ensuring that our military is prepared to fight and win our nations wars. I will stand against the Marxist indoctrination of our service members and hold accountable any flag officer who is not honoring their oath to support and defend the U.S. Constitution against all enemies, foreign and domestic. Committee on Natural Resources: We've seen in recent months the devastating effects of a Democrat plan to end U.S. energy independence by crushing hydrocarbon industries, especially in light of the obvious fact that no viable alternatives yet exist in a reliable, plentiful, and feasible way. It's not even clear that such an attack on hydrocarbon industries will have discernible effect on climate, while it is clear that the economic consequences are already hurting American families --- just a trip to the local gas station today tells the story for all of us. When I left the Army, I worked for nine years in the oil and natural gas industry at home and internationally in Israel. I learned there that simplistic thinking isn't enough to consider the way forward. It's also not enough to suggest that we can use an "all-of-the-above" strategy in deciding how best to use a finite amount of money and brainpower in developing new technologies. Whether it's looking at solar, hydropower, nuclear or other technologies to replace oil, natural gas, and coal we have to honestly determine if those other sources really are feasible and economically viable on a large scale. Oil, gas and coal remain vital --- and plentiful --- to the American economy; not only are they viable, but, as we're seeing in the Ukraine situation, they are crucial to a strong national defense. Committee on Intelligence: As an Army officer, I held a Top Secret clearance. Through my Army experience and my international experience in the oil and gas industry, it is clear to me that national-level intelligence is a critical factor in determining success and failure in the most important decisions in our country. We cannot allow that highly important function to be corrupted by politicians who use it to settle personal or party differences. We must also hold both our political appointees and career intelligence officials to a high standard of person conduct. My experience with intelligence officials tells me that the vast majority of them are patriotic, dedicated Americans who put the security of the nation above their own gain. We must also protect them from those who would use their power for anything less that the best interest of the nation. Again, I will go head-long into any assignment given, but now it's clear to you the committees I will seek. Our people, in this district, the state of Colorado, and the country as a whole, are profoundly affected by our congressional oversight. Serving our fellow citizens is a noble calling, and I will always adhere to that ethos. | | | | | | | == | | | | Campaign Update | | ---|--- | Yet another very busy week for Erik and the staff. Last Saturday, Erik made appearances in Fremont County. He was interviewed on KRLN radio in Canyon City by Lisa Hyams. Very interesting talk. Afterwards, Erik spent some time with the Canyon City Golden Age Center. After Canyon City, it was off to Salida for a private Meet & Greet at a constituent's home, followed by another one in Buena Vista where topics of concern included inflation, energy and education. Erik's thoughts were enthusiastically received by both crowds. Tuesday evening, Erik was closer to home in Lakewood for another private Meet & Greet and exuberant conversation around issues of the day, and what Erik will take to Washington. name: Bernie Sanders
subject: My endorsement
body:
Summer and I are fighting for a shared vision of Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, unions, and much more.
#
Hello Peter,
**I am proud to endorse Justice Democrat Summer Lee to represent Pennsylvania's 12th Congressional district.**
[](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/101108?refcode=em20220330-22641&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=22641%2E1203867%2Eff3hHn)
Summer and I have a lot in common, from beginning our careers as activists and organizers for working people, to getting involved at the local level — I ran for Mayor of Burlington, Summer ran for State Legislature, and we both did it to challenge a status quo that wasn’t delivering for working families in our communities.
We are fighting for a shared vision of Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, unions, good wages and safe conditions for every worker, to deliver real progress towards racial, economic, and environmental justice, and to do it all while refusing to accept corporate PAC money.
[Summer’s last FEC quarter deadline before Election Day is tomorrow night, Peter. Can you contribute $3 to Summer’s campaign today to send Summer to Congress to continue this fight for the families of PA-12?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/101108?refcode=em20220330-22641&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=22641%2E1203867%2Eff3hHn)
**[Contribute $3](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/101108?refcode=em20220330-22641&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=22641%2E1203867%2Eff3hHn)**
As an experienced community organizer, Summer Lee understands that working people desperately need leaders in Congress who will stand up to big money interests and fight for an agenda that puts poor and working people first.
From becoming the first Black woman ever to serve in the state legislature from Western Pennsylvania, to defeating dangerous fracking proposals, to passing urgently needed police accountability measures, to showing up on picket lines across the Commonwealth — **I know that Summer Lee is the courageous movement-builder we need in Congress.**
Progressive candidates, like Summer, recruited and endorsed by Justice Democrats in 2022 are up against corporate-backed candidates with unlimited sums of money. But we have something that they don't have, and that is a powerful movement of people who are saying enough is enough. It is time to elect candidates who will stand with working people, not the corporate elite.
We are just 48 days away from Summer’s primary election and another opportunity to elect a strong progressive to Congress. I've supported Summer since her first run for the state legislature, so I hope you will join me in supporting her now. [I am asking — will you chip in what you can to Summer's campaign before the end of the quarter to elect a true leader for working families to Congress?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/101108?refcode=em20220330-22641&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=22641%2E1203867%2Eff3hHn)
In solidarity,
Bernie Sanders

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank [here.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=23&akid=22641%2E1203867%2Eff3hHn) We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong. Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the [Centers for Disease Control](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=24&akid=22641%2E1203867%2Eff3hHn) and your state public health department.
---

body:
Former Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich joined David Perdue, Trump-endorsed candidate for Governor, on the campaign trail. | | | |
---
| | | **Newt Gingrich Joins David Perdue on the Trail**
---
| Friend,

Former Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich joined David Perdue, Trump-endorsed candidate for Governor, on the campaign trail and told the crowd, **_“Brian Kemp cost us control of the U.S. Senate and Brian Kemp took 16 electoral votes away from Donald Trump. Now don’t kid yourself, (Stacey Abrams) has a clear plan and Raffensperger and Kemp are dumb enough that they helped her.” _**
---
| [ ](https://davidperduega.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1eaf1761f5031bae92fd4e677&id=4a3acbdae4&e=89fb4d5220)
---
| [Watch More of Newt's Remarks Here](https://davidperduega.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1eaf1761f5031bae92fd4e677&id=05adc20170&e=89fb4d5220 "Watch More of Newt's Remarks Here")
---
| Newt and David spoke to large crowds in Fayetteville, Duluth, and Marietta. Last week, Gingrich formally endorsed Perdue for Governor of Georgia.
**Endorsing Perdue, Gingrich said,** "David Perdue is a lifelong job creator with a record of results. His natural instinct is to solve problems and bring people together. I firmly believe David Perdue is the only candidate who can unite the Republican Party, defeat Abrams, and help Georgia avoid Critical Race Theory indoctrination, higher taxes, and bigger bureaucracy. David Perdue has my full support and endorsement. His bold conservative vision will lead Georgia to a brighter future."

We hope to see you on the trail soon!
-Team Perdue

Hi Peter,
Friday’s bombshell decision by a state circuit court judge and the _conditional_ passage of a new map creates a lot of uncertainty for voters across our district.

**_Many are asking: What district am I in?_
It’s still unclear for many in Montgomery and Frederick counties.**

There’s still an outstanding court appeal.
---
| [_There is something you *can do* right now: Help us win! We have a *major* fundraising deadline tomorrow at midnight!_](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=2cb1d9f231&e=0faa9de128)

We have a choice in this primary: A social justice and accountability leader or an incumbent splitting his time between running a multi-billion dollar business and serving in Congress. I’ve _always_ put people first and will continue to lead on social justice and accountability as your Rep.

Stronger leadership in Congress benefits EVERYONE. No matter which district you’re ultimately in, **I’m still running in MD-6 and I still need your support to win.**

_We need more candidates that reach out and engage personally! That’s how our democracy should work._
With all of these changes, our campaign is having to pivot multiple times – _and we are_ – but we need more support. We reached out to thousands of voters that might be districted-out, just months before the primary! Yes, that’s incredibly frustrating _and_ we will persist!

Learning about your concerns, hopes and dreams for our district, state, country, and world has been priceless and worth it. It has been truly an honor to receive your time, consideration, and support.
[_Regardless of the outcome of this redistricting rollercoaster, I can still win, only with your continued support. Please donate today._](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=71f65d109a&e=0faa9de128)

THANK YOU!!
\- Ben

| | Dear Friend,

We've all watched as Portland rose to national fame for all the wrong reasons. And now, the radical agenda to defund the police is having lethal consequences for Oregonians. Just this week, The Oregonian reported on a shooting at a northeast Portland intersection -- _**the fourth deadly shooting at that intersection in the last eight months.**_

The government's first job is to keep its citizens safe._And here in Oregon, our leaders have failed._ I'm tired of watching us elect the same leaders and expecting different results. **That's why I'm running for governor.**

As a businesswoman in the tech industry, my focus is on solutions, not partisan bickering. In Salem, I'll bring that same approach as we forge concrete policies to fully fund law enforcement and keep our communities safe.

**_If you agree with me that Oregon needs a different type of leader, one who provides an outsider's perspective, will you stand with me and chip in $20 to our campaign?_**

name: Imani Oakley
subject: This is a fight for justice
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Oakley for Congress
body:
Peter,

As we approach our LAST end-of-quarter deadline tomorrow, I want to talk to you about what it is we’re fighting for.

If this campaign is about anything, it’s about justice — fighting back against injustice, securing justice for everyone who’s been left behind, and standing up for justice at home and abroad.

As a Black woman, I understand all too well the type of state violence inflicted on Black people here in the United States and how important it is to not just promote accountability here, but also abroad.

That’s why I’ve earned the support of organizations like AJP Action, one of the largest advocates for Palestinian liberation and a major player in the fight against injustice and human rights abuse by the Israeli government.

In fact, today is Palestine Land Day and I'm proud to stand with the Arab community in commemorating the violence that's been launched against them in the past and present.

We need more progressives in Washington who are committed to promoting justice and fighting for liberation. That’s exactly what I intend to do, and that’s exactly why I need your support. If you’re with me in the fight for justice at home and abroad, click here to chip in before time runs out. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e-io-march2022?refcode=eoq4]

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will be processed immediately.

Like any movement for real change, our fight for progress isn’t going to be easy. But justice isn’t easy. And I refuse to back down until everyone, at home and abroad, is free from the brutal injustice of state violence.

This campaign is a people-powered, progressive movement. We’re demanding REAL representation and REAL action, and we need your support.

With your help, I can keep speaking up for justice at home and abroad. Can you make a contribution before tomorrow’s deadline to support our progressive movement? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e-io-march2022?refcode=eoq4]

Thank you,
Imani

To: Peter
From: John Kasich
Date: March 23, 2022

In 1998, I wrote a book called "Courage is Contagious" and it profiled ordinary Americans whose courageous acts made a lasting impact on those around them.

Rightfully so, we reserve the word "courageous" for those among us who put themselves in harms way to help others or those who put themselves out there, with nothing to gain personally, in an effort to improve the lives of other people.

This has been on my mind in recent weeks as I look at the courageous acts of so many brave Ukrainians who are fighting to defend their homeland and their democratic values. Their very way of life is under attack by Russia's Putin and the defiance of Ukrainian President Zelensky has rallied the free world to their cause.

It was hard to imagine even a month or two ago that there would be something that could rally America's leaders in both parties to speak with one voice about anything positive, let alone a powerful call to fight to defend democracy. That is the power of courage and we need more of it in America.

Courage comes in all forms and any human being has the potential to make a positive impact. Just look at Ohio State college football player Harry Miller who stepped away from the sport to not only focus on his own mental health, but to share his story in the hopes that it will help others who may be struggling. [Take a look at this clip from his interview with the Today Show](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=54d14a721854449586d113321d4dfa62&_e=rNJaVoI1gB1Ui4mzlYoljjf7uMosPNeMW8nAz5jYAcVbDWbvXqrhg2TRDCNYbQnsC5k6qFEmDG48NP-L1HaKJrDwO16y_Rj-6wP8jhi4pMEgcH82tv7x55SVD_0I7fuXcESvvCzhj_ktvbIuctE4st6rUS2UVkb24oFQluvdo0pa6shVJMFsAT9RomLXYm_1SNuPVYFSmlOIGxMwEdE1-epNfgEtfV4aZrEz3Q71EGAatoWNP8WUa9Vy5eXAl4DaW35sAjlZHdGdhP9yye8Jd7laHQwd4wUpOHBWHr8_-Eo3PnjFhHMoiJ5tvVTZVw_X5Xf-MmZp_hcVg2XKOOYcKw%3D%3D).

The exceptional thing about courage is that the natural human reaction when we see it is to come together in some way. We are drawn to it instinctively and it can be such a powerful way to bring about positive change.

Courage really is contagious and it's up to each of us to find a way that we can make a positive impact in our own communities. It's my hope that we can help our elected leaders in Washington understand how courageous acts can work to unite us instead of dividing us for political gain.
I'm so proud to have you on the team and cannot thank you enough for all that you're doing to help heal America!

-John

Thank you for your interest in our campaign !

Peter,

It was a pleasure meeting you! Thanks so much for your interest in and potential willingness to help me with my Congressional campaign to " C lean U p T he H ouse" in Washington D.C.! If you have not already heard, we have hired some incredible staff to help us move this campaign forward. My new C ampaign C onsultant is Steve Kush (of Ed the Trucker fame!), and my new C ampaign M anager is Robert McGuire (an election integrity lawyer with a background in running campaigns). We’re also blessed with the talents of many other awesome team members as well , so rest assured, this campaign is in very capable hands! [ img: 😊 ] Robert McGuire will be your first point of contact for all the campaign needs and/or issues. Please expect to hear from him and/or our amazing new Volunteer Coordinator Catt Johnson or our wonderful Grassroots Outreach Director Cindy Allpress . Meanwhile, we need to make sure that all of your information is up to date in our new syste m. To help us with that, please click the red button at the bottom of this message, and you'll be re-directed to our volunteer form on our website. I know that you may have already filled it out in the past , but we're asking you to tell us again just to make sure our new systems have your information. So please enter your information one more time and pay special attention to letting us know of those areas where you’d be most willing to volunteer for the campaign. Last ly, but definitely not least, we are also working very hard to meet all of our campaign's fundraising goals. Donations of any amount help us to get our message out and reach more voters. If you possibly can make a donation, please [ CLICK HERE ] ( 1 ) to do so . Thanks again, and I look forward to seeing you soon!

Thanks so much for your interest in and potential willingness to help me with my Congressional campaign to " C lean U p T he H ouse" in Washington D.C.! If you have not already heard, we have hired some incredible staff to help us move this campaign forward. My new C ampaign C onsultant is Steve Kush (of Ed the Trucker fame!), and my new C ampaign M anager is Robert McGuire (an election integrity lawyer with a background in running campaigns). We’re also blessed with the talents of many other awesome team members as well , so rest assured, this campaign is in very capable hands! [ img: 😊 ] Robert McGuire will be your first point of contact for all the campaign needs and/or issues. Please expect to hear from him and/or our amazing new Volunteer Coordinator Catt Johnson or our wonderful Grassroots Outreach Director Cindy Allpress . Meanwhile, we need to make sure that all of your information is up to date in our new syste m. To help us with that, please click the red button at the bottom of this message, and you'll be re-directed to our volunteer form on our website. I know that you may have already filled it out in the past , but we're asking you to tell us again just to make sure our new systems have your information. So please enter your information one more time and pay special attention to letting us know of those areas where you’d be most willing to volunteer for the campaign. Last ly, but definitely not least, we are also working very hard to meet all of our campaign's fundraising goals. Donations of any amount help us to get our message out and reach more voters. subject: Why Alexandria is calling on Justice Clarence Thomas to resign

body:
A failure to hold Clarence Thomas accountable sends a loud, dangerous signal to the full court.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220330-2909-header&t=1&akid=2909%2E2526796%2ERfVlph)
You may have heard Justice Clarence Thomas discussed a lot in the news the past few days. This email will catch up on the who, what, and why Alexandria is calling on him to resign from the Supreme Court.
**First, the background...**
Shocking new reports show that Ginni Thomas – a far-right conspiracy theorist and the wife of Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas – personally pressured Trump's White House chief of staff to try to overturn the results of the 2020 presidential election.
In a series of text messages, Ginni Thomas encouraged Trump’s chief of staff to push false claims of voter fraud and pressured him to prevent the election from being certified.
In one text, Thomas tells Trump Chief of Staff Mark Meadows that "Biden and the Left is attempting the greatest Heist of our History".1
**Then Justice Thomas refused to recuse himself and voted to hide his wife’s involvement...**
Despite his wife's active role in Trump's attempted coup, Justice Thomas failed to recuse himself in a case regarding the release of records related to January 6 and he cast the lone dissenting vote to keep the White House records hidden from the Jan. 6 select committee – including the texts that involved his wife.
In response, Alexandria joined a handful of other Democrats in calling Justice Thomas to resign.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220330?refcode=em20220330-2909-P_FND_EXP_LEG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&refcode2=2909_2526796_RfVlph&akid=2909%2E2526796%2ERfVlph)
**Here’s why this matters, even if it seems unlikely to you that Thomas would resign:**
When progressives pushed for the first impeachment of Donald Trump for illegally withholding aid to Ukraine, initially many Democrats internally resisted it. Members of Congress like Alexandria were chastised for being “unrealistic” – saying that it would lead to nowhere.
But Alexandria knew that regardless of the outcome, someone would be left holding the bag on accountability. The question was: “Would we, the House, rather have to answer questions later of why we didn’t act, or have the Senate answer questions of why they acquitted?”
The debate was fierce and the opposition was real, but eventually public and internal pressure mounted to such a level that inaction became untenable for leadership and the party. Impeachment proceeded and when we look back – especially given the current violence against Ukraine by Russia – it’s hard to imagine if the naysayers had won and we chose not to act.
Often what seems like the righteous yet politically foolish thing in the short term ends up being the wisest choice in the long term. That’s why we shouldn’t dismiss any and all actions available to us to hold Clarence Thomas accountable.
**What happens if Congress doesn’t hold Thomas accountable?**
Congress must understand that a failure to hold Clarence Thomas accountable sends a loud, dangerous signal to the full court that his actions are fair game.
This is a tipping point, and inaction is a decision to erode and further delegitimize the Supreme Court. As Alexandria said, “We must go where the facts take us.”

Thank you for reading and we'll keep you informed about next steps.
